source.title: 研究生教育学科专业目录（2022年）

note.zh: 14 门类用于检索；方向标签、六个展示学科群与工作建议为本项目编排，不是完整官方专业目录。
note.en: The 14 categories support lookup. Direction tags, six display groups and work suggestions are project-authored, not a complete official program directory.

material.zh: 关键概念、原典与反对意见
material.en: Key concepts, primary texts and objections

action.zh: 拆出一条论证的前提与结论，对照原文检验关键推论
action.en: Separate premises from a conclusion and check the inference against the source

output.en: A concept, argument and counterexample map

check.zh: 概念是否前后一致；引文是否支持当前解释
check.en: Check consistent definitions and whether citations support the interpretation

material.zh: 变量字典、识别假设与样本口径
material.en: Variable definitions, identification assumptions and sample rules

action.zh: 核对样本筛选与识别思路，整理基准结果及替代解释
action.en: Check sample selection and identification, then organize baseline results and alternative explanations

output.zh: 识别假设与结果核对表
output.en: An identification and results checklist

check.zh: 区分相关性与因果主张；核对样本变化
check.en: Distinguish association from causal claims and trace sample changes

material.zh: 法规版本、判例与争议问题
material.en: Versions of statutes, cases and disputed questions

action.zh: 按同一争点比较法规依据与判例理由，写出适用边界
action.en: Compare statutes and case reasoning on one issue and record the limits of applicability

output.en: An issue, authority and case matrix

check.zh: 法律文本的日期、效力与引用位置是否准确
check.en: Verify dates, authority and citation locations of legal texts

material.zh: 政策文本、制度背景与案例
material.en: Policy texts, institutional context and cases

action.zh: 对照政策目标、执行机制和实际证据，整理案例差异
action.en: Compare objectives, implementation mechanisms and evidence across cases

output.zh: 政策机制与案例对照表
output.en: A policy mechanism and case comparison

check.zh: 区分政策表述、解释和观察证据
check.en: Distinguish policy statements, interpretations and observed evidence

material.zh: 访谈转录、田野笔记与编码本
material.en: Transcripts, field notes and a codebook

action.zh: 精读一段材料，补充编码定义并保留不符合预期的片段
action.en: Read one passage closely, refine codes and retain disconfirming excerpts

output.en: A coding memo with source locations

check.zh: 匿名化、语境与反例是否一并保留
check.en: Preserve anonymity, context and counterexamples

material.zh: 教学情境、量表条目与学习证据
material.en: Teaching context, instrument items and learning evidence

action.zh: 对齐研究问题、测量条目与教学过程，梳理资料缺口
action.en: Align questions, instrument items and teaching processes, then identify evidence gaps

output.en: A question, measure and context map

check.zh: 测量是否对应研究问题；同意与资料权限是否清楚
check.en: Check alignment of measures and clarity of consent and data permissions

material.zh: 构念定义、量表或任务与分析计划
material.en: Construct definitions, measures or tasks and an analysis plan

action.zh: 核对计分规则、排除标准与分析计划，整理构念对应证据
action.en: Check scoring, exclusion rules and the analysis plan against construct evidence

output.en: A construct and measurement checklist

check.zh: 预先设定与事后探索是否分开记录
check.en: Record planned and exploratory analyses separately

material.zh: 测量协议、训练记录与运动数据
material.en: Measurement protocols, training logs and movement data

action.zh: 对齐测量时间、条件和编号，检查数据单位与缺失情况
action.en: Align measurement times, conditions and identifiers; inspect units and missingness

output.zh: 运动数据与条件核对表
output.en: A movement data and conditions checklist

check.zh: 研究整理不替代训练、康复或采集的既定专业方案
check.en: Keep research organization consistent with established training, rehabilitation and collection protocols

material.zh: 文本版本、关键段落与研究争论
material.en: Text editions, key passages and scholarly debates

action.zh: 细读一个片段，将文本证据与核心论点逐项对应
action.en: Read a passage closely and connect textual evidence to the central argument

output.en: Traceable close-reading notes

check.zh: 解释是否超出文本证据；版本页码是否完整
check.en: Check interpretive scope, edition and page references

material.zh: 语料、转写规范与语境信息
material.en: Corpus data, transcription conventions and context

action.zh: 对齐语料来源、标注口径与分析单位，比较代表性例子
action.en: Align corpus sources, annotation rules and units; compare representative examples

output.en: An annotation and example register

check.zh: 保留例子的上下文、来源与选择理由
check.en: Retain context, provenance and selection rationale

material.zh: 史料、版本、年代与相关研究
material.en: Primary sources, editions, dates and scholarship

action.zh: 交叉核对一项叙述的史料依据，标注材料间的差异
action.en: Cross-check the sources for one historical account and annotate disagreements

output.zh: 史料互证与年代对照表
output.en: A source corroboration and chronology table

check.zh: 区分史料记载与现代解释
check.en: Distinguish source testimony from modern interpretation

material.zh: 器物编号、地层记录与档案
material.en: Object identifiers, stratigraphic records and archives

action.zh: 核对编号、出土语境与照片记录，梳理同类材料
action.en: Check identifiers, contexts and photographs, then organize comparable material

output.en: An object, context and image index

check.zh: 保留原始记录、位置关系与授权条件
check.en: Preserve original records, contextual relationships and access conditions

material.zh: 定义、假设、证明草稿与反例
material.en: Definitions, assumptions, proof drafts and counterexamples

action.zh: 展开一处省略的推导，检查边界情形并标出未证步骤
action.en: Expand an omitted step, test boundary cases and mark unproved claims

output.zh: 证明缺口与边界检查表
output.en: A proof-gap and boundary-case checklist

check.zh: 结论所用假设是否齐全；是否存在反例
check.en: Check every required assumption and possible counterexamples

material.zh: 模型假设、推导与观测或模拟结果
material.en: Model assumptions, derivations and observations or simulations

action.zh: 核对量纲、近似条件与一个可验证的模型预期
action.en: Check dimensions, approximation conditions and one testable model implication

output.en: An assumptions, dimensions and validation table

check.zh: 标注近似的适用范围与误差来源
check.en: State approximation limits and error sources

material.zh: 实验批次、表征文件与已定实验记录
material.en: Batch records, characterization files and established protocols

action.zh: 关联批次与原始表征文件，检查空白、对照和重复记录
action.en: Link batches to raw characterization files and check blanks, controls and replicates

output.en: A batch and characterization index

check.zh: 实验操作沿用已批准方案，记录条件与版本
check.en: Follow approved procedures and preserve condition and version records

material.zh: 样本元数据、对照设计与原始读数
material.en: Sample metadata, controls and raw measurements

action.zh: 核对样本关系、批次和对照，整理可复查的分析入口
action.en: Check sample relationships, batches and controls; organize a reproducible analysis entry point

output.en: A sample, batch and control table

check.zh: 区分生物学重复与技术重复，保留原始值
check.en: Distinguish biological and technical replicates and preserve raw values

material.zh: 坐标、时段、仪器与观测记录
material.en: Coordinates, time intervals, instruments and observations

action.zh: 对齐空间坐标与时间尺度，核对校准及缺测标记
action.en: Align spatial and temporal scales; check calibration and missing-data flags

output.zh: 时空观测与质量标记表
output.en: A spatiotemporal observation and quality-flag table

check.zh: 说明坐标系、时间基准与观测覆盖范围
check.en: Document coordinate systems, time standards and coverage

material.zh: 代码版本、测试用例与运行环境
material.en: Code revisions, test cases and runtime environments

action.zh: 复现一条关键流程，记录输入、环境、输出及失败用例
action.en: Reproduce one critical path and record inputs, environment, outputs and failures

output.en: A reproducible run record

check.zh: 代码、依赖版本与报告结果能否一一对应
check.en: Link code and dependency versions to reported results

material.zh: 数据划分、基线、配置与评估指标
material.en: Data splits, baselines, configurations and evaluation metrics

action.zh: 核对数据划分与基线，再整理一项消融或误差分析
action.en: Check data splits and baselines, then organize one ablation or error analysis

output.en: A baseline, ablation and error comparison

check.zh: 检查数据泄漏、比较条件与算力预算
check.en: Check leakage, comparable conditions and compute budget

material.zh: 结构版本、边界条件与测试记录
material.en: Design revisions, boundary conditions and test records

action.zh: 对照结构改动与性能指标，核对仿真和测试的条件
action.en: Connect design changes to metrics and compare simulation and test conditions

output.zh: 结构改动与性能追踪表
output.en: A design-change and performance log

check.zh: 边界条件、单位与测量误差是否一致
check.en: Check boundary conditions, units and measurement uncertainty

material.zh: 参数表、波形或日志与测试配置
material.en: Parameters, waveforms or logs and test configurations

action.zh: 对齐配置与测量记录，复查异常区段及对照条件
action.en: Align configurations and measurements; inspect anomalous intervals and controls

output.en: A configuration, measurement and anomaly log

check.zh: 核对采样率、单位、校准与环境条件
check.en: Check sampling rates, units, calibration and environment

material.zh: 制备批次、表征与性能记录
material.en: Preparation batches, characterization and performance records

action.zh: 串联制备、结构和性能证据，标注不同批次的差异
action.en: Connect preparation, structure and performance evidence; mark batch differences

output.en: A processing, structure and performance table

check.zh: 保留原始曲线、样本批次和重复记录
check.en: Preserve raw curves, batches and replicate records

material.zh: 场地资料、模型版本与设计约束
material.en: Site evidence, model revisions and design constraints

action.zh: 对齐场地证据与模型假设，整理设计选择的比较依据
action.en: Align site evidence and model assumptions; compare the basis for design choices

output.en: A constraints, options and validation table

check.zh: 区分设计假设、实测数据与规范要求
check.en: Distinguish design assumptions, observations and code requirements

material.zh: 工况、采样点与检测记录
material.en: Operating conditions, sampling sites and measurements

action.zh: 对齐工况变化与采样时段，检查进出项及记录完整性
action.en: Align operating changes with sampling periods and inspect inputs, outputs and record completeness

output.en: An operating-condition and sample log

check.zh: 核对单位、时间滞后和质量控制记录
check.en: Check units, time lags and quality-control records

material.zh: 地块、物候、处理与样本记录
material.en: Plots, phenology, treatments and sample records

action.zh: 核对地块与处理编号，整理物候、环境和采样元数据
action.en: Check plot and treatment identifiers; organize phenology, environment and sampling metadata

output.en: A plot, treatment and sample ledger

check.zh: 实际物候与必要采样窗口优先
check.en: Respect real phenology and essential sampling windows

material.zh: 样地、物种、坐标与监测记录
material.en: Plots, species, coordinates and monitoring records

action.zh: 核对样地定位与物种记录，对齐监测时间和方法
action.en: Check plot locations and species records; align monitoring times and methods

output.en: A plot-monitoring index

check.zh: 说明观测努力、方法差异与缺测情况
check.en: Record observation effort, method differences and missingness

material.zh: 个体编号、分组与观察记录
material.en: Individual identifiers, groups and observations

action.zh: 核对个体与分组对应，整理观察周期和既定记录
action.en: Check identifiers against groups and organize observation periods and established records

output.en: An individual and observation-period ledger

check.zh: 照护与连续观察依既定方案进行
check.en: Maintain care and continuous observation under established protocols

material.zh: 病例定义、索引日期、终点与随访记录
material.en: Case definitions, index dates, endpoints and follow-up records

action.zh: 核对入排标准、索引日期与结局定义，整理缺失及排除原因
action.en: Check eligibility, index dates and outcomes; organize missingness and exclusion reasons

output.zh: 病例流程与变量核对表
output.en: A case-flow and variable checklist

check.zh: 研究记录与诊疗安排分开；核对权限与匿名化
check.en: Separate research records from care commitments and check access and de-identification

material.zh: 样本来源、批次、对照与检测结果
material.en: Sample origins, batches, controls and assay results

action.zh: 对齐样本信息与检测批次，整理对照和重复证据
action.en: Align sample metadata with assay batches and organize controls and replicates

output.en: A sample, batch and result map

check.zh: 结果是否可追溯到原始记录与既定方案
check.en: Trace results to raw records and established protocols

material.zh: 暴露定义、结局、分母与数据字典
material.en: Exposure definitions, outcomes, denominators and a data dictionary

action.zh: 核对人群分母、观察期与变量定义，整理偏倚和缺失处理
action.en: Check denominators, observation periods and variable definitions; document bias and missing-data handling

output.en: A population and variable-definition table

check.zh: 时间先后、混杂与选择过程是否说明
check.en: Document temporal order, confounding and selection

material.zh: 样品批次、分析方法与测量记录
material.en: Sample batches, analytical methods and measurements

action.zh: 对齐批次与分析方法版本，核查对照、校准和原始记录
action.en: Align batches with analytical method versions; check controls, calibration and raw records

output.en: A batch and method traceability table

check.zh: 沿用既定研究方案，区分研究数据与临床建议
check.en: Follow established research protocols and keep research data distinct from clinical advice

material.zh: 服务流程、访谈或观察与结局定义
material.en: Service workflows, interviews or observations and outcome definitions

action.zh: 对齐服务过程与资料来源，整理障碍、资源和结局口径
action.en: Align service processes with evidence sources; organize barriers, resources and outcome definitions

output.en: A service-process and evidence matrix

check.zh: 保护参与者信息，保留不同角色的语境
check.en: Protect participant information and retain role-specific context

name.zh: 军事学文献与组织研究

material.zh: 公开文献、历史材料与组织研究问题
material.en: Public literature, historical material and organizational questions

action.zh: 梳理公开材料的出处、术语和论证范围，比较不同解释
action.en: Trace public sources, terminology and argument scope; compare interpretations

output.zh: 公开文献与观点对照表
output.en: A public-source and interpretation table

check.zh: 仅整理有权使用的资料，区分文献研究与实际行动
check.en: Use authorized material and distinguish scholarship from operational action

material.zh: 组织情境、变量或案例与理论机制
material.en: Organizational context, variables or cases and theoretical mechanisms

action.zh: 对照理论机制与变量或案例证据，记录替代解释
action.en: Compare mechanisms with variables or case evidence and record alternatives

output.en: A mechanism, evidence and context table

check.zh: 管理含义是否超出样本和识别范围
check.en: Keep practical implications within the sample and identification limits

material.zh: 作品版本、参考材料与创作日志
material.en: Work versions, references and process journals

action.zh: 围绕一个表达问题比较两个版本，记录选择理由与反馈
action.en: Compare two versions around one expressive question and document choices and feedback

output.zh: 作品迭代与研究反思页
output.en: A work-iteration and research-reflection sheet

check.zh: 作品变化与研究问题之间是否有明确联系
check.en: Make the connection between creative changes and the research question explicit

material.zh: 谱本、排练记录与授权音视频
material.en: Scores, rehearsal logs and authorized recordings

action.zh: 围绕一个表达片段对照记录，整理处理方式与研究观察
action.en: Compare records of one passage and document interpretive choices and observations

output.zh: 片段分析与排练反思记录
output.en: A passage-analysis and rehearsal-reflection record

check.zh: 说明记录情境、版本与使用授权
check.en: Document context, version and usage permissions

material.zh: 设计问题、原型与用户反馈
material.en: Design questions, prototypes and user feedback

action.zh: 对照一个用户需求迭代原型，记录取舍及验证证据
action.en: Iterate a prototype against one user need and record trade-offs and validation evidence

output.en: A prototype revision and validation record

check.zh: 区分审美偏好、用户证据与研究结论
check.en: Distinguish aesthetic preference, user evidence and research conclusions

material.zh: 各领域术语、资料与共同研究问题
material.en: Terminology, evidence and a shared question across fields

action.zh: 建立跨领域概念和数据接口的对应关系，定位一处衔接问题
action.en: Map concepts and data interfaces across fields and locate one integration issue

output.en: A cross-field concept and interface map

check.zh: 同名概念是否同义；单位、尺度和假设能否衔接
check.en: Check meanings, units, scales and assumptions across fields

steps.zh: 定位一个问题的原始出处，记录版本与页码
steps.en: Locate primary evidence for one question and record edition and pages

steps.zh: 比较支持、反对与例外材料，保留语境
steps.en: Compare support, objections and exceptions in context

steps.zh: 写一段论证并把每个关键判断连回出处
steps.en: Draft a paragraph with each key claim linked to its source

output.en: A source-to-claim map

check.zh: 引文、转述与个人解释分开标注
check.en: Label quotation, paraphrase and interpretation separately

steps.zh: 核对授权与匿名化，选取可使用的材料
steps.en: Check consent and anonymization; choose authorized material

steps.zh: 对一个片段编码，记录定义变化与反例
steps.en: Code one excerpt and log definition changes and counterexamples

steps.zh: 将主题与例证连接，写一则分析备忘录
steps.en: Connect themes to excerpts in an analytic memo

output.zh: 编码本更新与分析备忘录
output.en: A codebook update and analytic memo

check.zh: 保留语境与不一致证据，不只摘取支持性片段
check.en: Retain context and inconsistent evidence, not only supportive excerpts

steps.zh: 核对构念、题项、计分和版本
steps.en: Check constructs, items, scoring and versions

steps.zh: 检查缺失、异常与预定排除标准
steps.en: Inspect missingness, anomalies and predefined exclusions

steps.zh: 整理测量表现与研究问题之间的关系
steps.en: Document how measurement evidence relates to the question

output.en: A measurement and data-check record

check.zh: 保留原始数据与处理日志，说明探索性改动
check.en: Preserve raw data and logs and label exploratory changes

steps.zh: 核对样本口径、变量字典和时间关系
steps.en: Check sample rules, variable definitions and temporal order

steps.zh: 运行已有分析或最小验证，保留日志与配置
steps.en: Run an existing analysis or a minimal check and save logs and configuration

steps.zh: 检查结果与假设的对应，列出稳健性问题
steps.en: Connect results to assumptions and list robustness questions

output.zh: 可复查分析记录与结果表
output.en: A reproducible analysis record and results table

check.zh: 报告缺失、排除、探索范围与不确定性
check.en: Report missingness, exclusions, exploration and uncertainty

steps.zh: 列清定义、假设和要证明的命题
steps.en: List definitions, assumptions and the proposition

steps.zh: 补齐一个推导环节，测试特殊与边界情形
steps.en: Complete one derivation step and test special and boundary cases

steps.zh: 标记已证、依赖结果与待证部分
steps.en: Mark proved, dependent and unproved components

output.zh: 可继续检查的证明草稿
output.en: An inspectable proof draft

check.zh: 每一步推理都能回到明确的条件
check.en: Tie each inference to explicit conditions

steps.zh: 固定代码、环境、数据版本与评估设置
steps.en: Fix code, environment, data versions and evaluation settings

steps.zh: 先跑最小可复现用例，再做预算内的比较
steps.en: Run a minimal reproducible case before a budgeted comparison

steps.zh: 保存配置、随机性来源、日志和错误案例
steps.en: Save configurations, randomness sources, logs and failure cases

output.zh: 运行清单、结果与错误案例
output.en: A run manifest, results and failure cases

check.zh: 测试数据、比较条件与资源预算保持清楚
check.en: Keep test data, comparison conditions and resource budgets explicit

steps.zh: 对照既定方案检查预约、样本与记录准备
steps.en: Check bookings, samples and documentation against the established protocol

steps.zh: 整理既定实验的批次、对照与原始读数
steps.en: Organize batches, controls and raw readings from established experiments

steps.zh: 记录偏差、异常与后续需要核实的问题
steps.en: Log deviations, anomalies and questions for follow-up

output.zh: 批次记录与原始数据索引
output.en: A batch record and raw-data index

check.zh: 连续操作和实验条件依既定方案，不按通用时间块中断
check.en: Keep continuous operations and conditions aligned with the established protocol

steps.zh: 核对授权、入排标准、索引日期与终点定义
steps.en: Check authorization, eligibility, index dates and endpoint definitions

steps.zh: 核查随访窗口、字段缺项与排除原因
steps.en: Check follow-up windows, missing fields and exclusion reasons

steps.zh: 整理匿名化数据字典与待核查事项
steps.en: Prepare a de-identified data dictionary and query list

output.zh: 病例流程、字典与核查清单
output.en: A case flow, dictionary and query list

check.zh: 研究整理服从既定诊疗与随访安排
check.en: Fit research organization around established care and follow-up commitments

steps.zh: 核对预约、实际窗口、编号与设备记录
steps.en: Check appointments, real windows, identifiers and equipment records

steps.zh: 整理既定采样或观察的时间、位置与条件
steps.en: Organize time, location and conditions for planned sampling or observation

steps.zh: 同步原始记录、备份与交接信息
steps.en: Synchronize raw records, backups and handover information

output.en: A traceable field-record package

check.zh: 实际窗口、天气和已定流程优先
check.en: Respect real windows, weather and established procedures

steps.zh: 明确一个设计或创作问题及评价依据
steps.en: Define one creative or design question and its evaluation basis

steps.zh: 保留旧版本，围绕该问题完成一次迭代
steps.en: Preserve the prior version and make one question-led iteration

steps.zh: 整理反馈、取舍与研究反思
steps.en: Organize feedback, trade-offs and research reflection

output.en: A version comparison and practice reflection

check.zh: 同时保存作品和产生研究判断的过程证据
check.en: Preserve both the work and the process evidence behind research judgments

steps.zh: 核对检索范围、日期与纳入标准
steps.en: Check search scope, dates and eligibility criteria

steps.zh: 记录筛选或提取决定，保留排除原因
steps.en: Log screening or extraction decisions and exclusion reasons

steps.zh: 核对证据表、偏倚问题与综合口径
steps.en: Check evidence tables, bias concerns and synthesis definitions

output.zh: 检索、筛选与提取追踪表
output.en: A search, screening and extraction log

check.zh: 区分协议内分析与后续调整并记录理由
check.en: Distinguish planned analyses from later changes and log reasons

steps.zh: 明确不同资料各回答什么问题
steps.en: State which question each evidence stream addresses

steps.zh: 对齐样本、时间与概念，保留互相矛盾的发现
steps.en: Align samples, times and concepts while retaining conflicting findings

steps.zh: 制作联合展示并记录整合后的解释边界
steps.en: Create a joint display and state the limits of integration

output.en: A joint display of evidence streams

check.zh: 整合结论能追溯到各自的方法与资料
check.en: Trace integrated conclusions to each method and evidence source

action.zh: 选择当前最有依据、能独立推进的一步
action.en: Choose an evidence-grounded step that can move forward independently

output.zh: 一份可复查的阶段产物
output.en: One reviewable intermediate output

check.zh: 下一步的输入和完成标志是否清楚
check.en: Make the next input and completion condition clear

action.zh: 比较已有解释与尚未解决的问题，收紧一个可研究的问题
action.en: Compare existing explanations with unresolved issues and narrow one researchable question

output.en: A research-question card and feasibility list

check.zh: 问题是否有资料基础、研究价值与可完成范围
check.en: Check evidence access, value and feasible scope

action.zh: 把问题、资料、方法、预期贡献与现实约束逐项对齐
action.en: Align the question, evidence, methods, intended contribution and practical constraints

output.en: A question, method and evidence roadmap

check.zh: 关键假设、权限、资源和替代方案是否明确
check.en: Clarify assumptions, permissions, resources and fallback options

action.zh: 先检查一个最小流程能否产生可解释、可保存的记录
action.en: Check whether one minimal workflow yields interpretable, preservable records

output.zh: 预研记录与方案调整清单
output.en: A pilot record and proposed adjustments

check.zh: 先核实流程和记录完整性，再决定扩大范围
check.en: Verify workflow and record completeness before expanding scope

action.zh: 按既定方案推进资料或实验记录，维护编号与版本对应
action.en: Follow the established plan while maintaining identifiers and version links

output.zh: 当次资料台账与质量记录
output.en: A collection ledger and quality record

check.zh: 预约、权限、关键窗口与完整流程是否得到遵守
check.en: Respect bookings, permissions, essential windows and complete procedures

action.zh: 连接原始材料、处理步骤和结果，核查一个关键解释
action.en: Connect raw evidence, processing and results; examine one key interpretation

output.en: A results table and validation log

check.zh: 区分预定与探索分析，记录替代解释和不确定性
check.en: Separate planned and exploratory analyses; record alternatives and uncertainty

action.zh: 围绕一个主张组织段落、图表与引用，补齐证据链
action.en: Build paragraphs, figures and references around one claim and its evidence

output.zh: 一节草稿与主张—证据表
output.en: A section draft and claim-evidence map

check.zh: 结论、图表、正文与引用是否一致
check.en: Align conclusions, figures, prose and citations

action.zh: 拆解一条评审意见，定位修改位置并准备对应依据
action.en: Break down one review comment, locate the revision and prepare supporting evidence

output.en: A comment, revision and response map

check.zh: 回复是否回答原问题，稿件和附件是否同步
check.en: Answer the original concern and keep manuscript and supplements aligned

action.zh: 围绕问题、方法、发现和边界整理一段清晰讲述
action.en: Build a clear account of the question, methods, findings and limits

output.en: A presentation segment and question cards

check.zh: 每个核心结论是否能指向证据并说明局限
check.en: Support each main conclusion with evidence and its limits

action.zh: 整理最终版本、数据字典、运行说明与授权范围
action.en: Organize final versions, dictionaries, run instructions and access conditions

output.en: A handover-ready research package

check.zh: 后续读者能否定位材料、理解版本并复查结果
check.en: Enable later readers to locate evidence, understand versions and inspect results
